prerequisite: A few clearly identified objects to delete, handles already verified
fixture_requirements: At least one polyline, one line and one text (verifies the detail fields for all three types)
A handle list containing one handle that does not exist in the drawing (verifies not_found is not silent)
assertions: dry_run:true reports without deleting: details are complete, erased == 0, drawing dbmod unchanged
details must be collected before deleting: type/layer/elevation/vertex count/closed/length/area; the list stays in the result after deletion (irreversible operations keep evidence)
named handles missing from the drawing go to not_found without throwing; the rest are deleted
when none of the handles is found, throw instead of returning a 'successful' erased:0

In-memory change only: takes effect only with an explicit save_dwg
